tasks.title: Roof details on a stair or slab write a nonexistent block id (raw roof material passed to _solidify_roof_under)
tasks.notes: Found 2026-10-29 by the designer of the Hartley Library redo (w33830050, southampton-build); not verified in game. Cause class: Translation, same family as #189. In lib/builds/feature_build.py the detail path calls self._solidify_roof_under(at, size, rm, supported) at ~2744 with the raw roof material name rm, while the other caller (~2686) converts it with block_family_variants(rm)['full']. For a slab-family material (deepslate_tile) the pad under a detail standing on a roof stair or slab is therefore written as minecraft:deepslate_tile, which does not exist (the full block is deepslate_tiles), so that cell stays air and the detail hovers. The designer avoided it by putting the ducts only on full-block cells; moving a detail onto a stair or slab brings it back. Deliver: convert once inside _solidify_roof_under (or at the ~2744 call) via block_family_variants(mat)['full'], so both callers pass the same kind of name; the dry run's unknown-block-id warning (#189) must stay silent for it. Files: lib/builds/feature_build.py, lib/builds/test_feature_build.py. Proof: unit test with a deepslate_tile roof, a detail standing on a stair and on a slab cell: the pad cell holds minecraft:deepslate_tiles and no unknown id is planned; existing detail tests pass. No live-world test. Helps: any building with a slab-family roof and details on stepped roofs, all worlds.
